User.title: User Profile
User.description: User profile containing roles, preferences, and Google Calendar syncing settings.

uid.description: The unique Firebase Auth User ID

displayName.description: The displayed name of the player or DM

gmailCalendarSync.description: True if player turns on Google Calendar sync using their Gmail account

Campaign.title: Campaign Settings
Campaign.description: Campaign metadata including session tracking, DM info, and roster configuration.

name.description: Campaign name (e.g., Vaults, The Keep, Vampire 5E)

sessionCounter.description: Total number of sessions played so far

currentWeekRange.description: The active scheduling week range (e.g., '1-7 June')

dmUserId.description: The Firebase Auth user ID of the DM

playerUids.description: Array of user IDs participating in the campaign

UserAvailability.title: Player Availability
UserAvailability.description: A player or DM's availability selections and notes for a specific campaign and week.

playerName.description: The display name of the player

selections.description: Map of Bulgarian weekday names to status (PLAY, SKIP, MAYBE, LATE 1 HR, NO-VOTE)

GameSession.title: D&D Game Session
GameSession.description: An upcoming, proposed, or completed game session.

proposedDays.description: Days proposed for the gaming session

calendarEventId.description: The associated Google Calendar event ID in the DM's calendar

sentOneDaySummary.description: Whether the summary was emailed to the DM 24 hours prior

campaigns/{campaignId}/availabilities/{u.description: Matches user availability inside a campaign context
